in_marathi.name: Poonam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Poonam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Poonam is derived from the Sanskrit word 'poonam' which means 'a cluster of moonbeams'. This name evokes the image of a beautiful, radiant moonlit night.

vedic_reference.note: Poonam is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word पूनामि (pūnāmi), meaning 'the moon's lotus seat' or 'the lotus on the moon's lap'. It is also mentioned in the Hindu scriptures as a name of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
